text:
maya: starting bring-up for velvet-7b (from vendor). doing int4 q8h conversion now, hit weird embed drift vs fp16 baseline :thinking_face:

ravi: what do you mean by drift? numbers?

maya: small example: fp16 ppl=18.2, int4 ppl=22.9 on our summarization eval set. embeddings cosine drops ~0.12 on averaged anchors.

sylvia: that magnitude points at either tokenmap or rotary mismatch, not just quant noise. did you run tokenizer roundtrip?

maya: yep. token ids match for most tokens but noticed vendor uses an extra soft-sentinel token at id 32000 for BPE edges.

jonathan: ah — soft-sentinel can shift kv cache alignments if we assume vocab contiguous. could cause prefix mismatch for rotary phases.

maya: i tried a quick patch mapping 32000 -> 0 during conversion. reran small sample, ppl improved to 20.8 and embed drop went to 0.06. progress but not fixed.

ravi: can you paste the conversion command and quant config?

maya: sure:

```bash
python convert_model.py --src velvet_fp16 --dst velvet_int4_q8h --quant backend=int4,mode=q8h --tokenmap map_32000_to_zero.json --rotary headwise=true
```

triage-bot: conversion job 48219 completed (90s). artifacts: s3://redwood-onboard/velvet/48219/

jonathan: curious about your rotary flag. velvet's reference exporter seems to have per-head scaling baked into weights, not the usual head-dim interleave. if we treat it as standard headwise we might double-scale.

sylvia: check the rotary exponent ordering. vendor doc: "rotary_scale: fractional per-dim, stored as [even,odd] interleaved" — that is nonstandard for our converters.

maya: i dumped first-layer rotary matrix and compared. ordering is indeed interleaved-even/odd instead of contiguous. quick script to reorder fixed indexing and improved ppl to 19.4. embeddings now within 0.02 of fp16 for our small set.

ravi: nice. still seeing residual quality gap in longer summaries?

maya: yes, at 1024 tokens we get some hallucination increase. suspect kv-cache offsets: vendor uses 1-based position sentinel in metadata so our kv indexing is off by one for past context when doing prefix cache.

jonathan: try applying an index-offset adjustment during export: decrement stored pos by 1 before serializing caches. also confirm causal mask dims after reorder.

maya: will do. one more thing: quant calibration histogram shows large spikes for ~12 tokens (punctuation heavy). might need per-channel scaling for those proj weights.

ravi: try remap with per-channel symmetric clip for proj layers only, keep out_proj in fp16. that often helps attention score stability.

maya: running three variants: (A) index-offset + rotary reorder; (B) + per-channel proj scale; (C) keep out_proj fp16 + B. will run evals overnight.

triage-bot: evaluation suite queued: job 48220 (A), 48221 (B), 48222 (C). ETA ~6h.

sylvia: also add a small prompt-set regression test: generate QA from 50 prompts used in production to check answer drift. embed cosine + rouge should be recorded.

maya: adding that. thanks all. tagging @jonathan for follow-up on converter patches. :thumbsup:

jonathan: I can take a look tomorrow morning, will add a converter flag for interleaved-rotary-order and guard for sentinel token ids in tokenmap module.

ravi: once you have converter changes, let's run a dedupe-check across token maps so we don't silently remap two ids to same target. saw that earlier with map_32000_to_zero.json which overlapped with BOS id.

maya: noted — i had a quick hack that did create BOS collision, will update mapping to avoid that.

triage-bot: job 48220 finished (A): ppl=19.6, embed-drop=0.04. job 48221 finished (B): ppl=18.9, embed-drop=0.01. job 48222 finished (C): ppl=18.3, embed-drop=0.005.

maya: great — C is essentially on-par with fp16 baseline. leaving run overnight on longer anchors for sanity.

sylvia: can we capture the exact diff that fixed hallucinations? looks like out_proj fp16 mattered. add that as default for velvet-7b int4 profile in model catalog with note about interleaved rotary and sentinel token.

jonathan: will open PR to converter with tests and a new profile under models/velvet/README.md describing: tokenmap special-case, rotary-order flag, out_proj fp16 whitelist.

ravi: awesome. once PR lands, schedule a dedicated rollout to staging dedicated capacity to validate latency/cost tradeoffs.

maya: thanks team. will paste final artifacts and eval CSV here after the long-run. :rocket:
